blocks.name: Last session
blocks.plain: Two sessions ran on the same tree all evening. One turned the board into pages and parked them. The other launched eleven creator cases, lost five when the process died, and stood down on your word. The box lost DARKROOM somewhere in between.

items.t: **The board became a page** — [[sitrep|SITREP]] v0 through v0.4 in one evening: the explainer register, tooltips depth 3, keys 0–7, a GLOSSARY panel. Colorway ruled: the creator-cases palette for every internal board; the rose stays with [[darkroom|DARKROOM]].

**[[bolo45|BOLO 45]] got its own page** — the five-paragraph order ([[smeac|SMEAC]]) with the next action on top, governed by [[speed|SPEED]] · [[focus|FOCUS]] · [[boldness|BOLDNESS]]. You ruled [[frago|FRAGO]] as its name, then split it: **[[opord|OPORD]] is the page (provisional), FRAGO is the update pushed onto it (ruled).**

**[[soi|SOI]] ruled as the glossary's name** — and its own dashboard in the Marine SOI format (edition · effective · supersedes · authentication · codebook · changes). Built at `_tools/soi/`, never published. The pages then parked to `oscar-mike/pages.md` with a six-step resume order.

**Wave one of the creator cases was cut short** — eleven agents launched at 16:28; the process exited mid-wave. Six landed (Ellexxaurus · Hungryanuz · Gape Game · PeggingOnlyOfficial · babylite · Bilbuana); five never did (Bad Dragon Slayer · BottomToys · Michael Vegas · Tweetney · Coco Lovecock). You said "don't restart anything." 15 [[creator-case|case files]] on disk, every header [[ttp|TTP]].

**Rulings on BOLO 45:** scope **M** (lane C, then the 21-name core) · the lessons block is **TTP**, singular, over [[gouge|GOUGE]] · [[rtb|RTB]] replaces sweep · [[charlie-mike|Charlie Mike]] resumes a card. Both of BOLO 45's open calls closed.

**The [[register|performer register]] grew to 155 names / 30 creators** — the lane-C list of 15 added (two seats still nameless: a 3D still artist, a Reddit-native grower), LushianaFitness added at 18:39, [[rebel-rhyder|Rebel Rhyder]]'s row applied.
**The [[nasa-girl|NASA girl]]'s case landed** — electrical engineer, two years in aerospace, in her own words; NASA was Rocco Siffredi's word only. Flag: she still sits in the gooner-lane table.

**RTB executed on one card** — the creator-cases card went home (STATE · BOLO 45 · the case nodes · `_tools/creator-cases/`); the three stale receipts cleared. 23 cards still parked. A 9/10 journal entry exists now; 9/9 still has none.
**[[the-box|The box]]:** [[stash|Stash]] up, [[darkroom|DARKROOM]] relaunched 9/11 on "run the darkroom". Tree clean. No agents in flight.
